en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a tall square minaret attached to a mosque in a traditional North African medina. The tower has small windows, decorative crenellations near the top, and Arabic calligraphy around one level. Below, arched doorways and flat-roofed buildings surround a narrow street where several robed figures walk. The caption at the bottom reads in French: "KAIROUAN. – MOSQUÉE DE LA PORTE DE TUNIS LL" along with the number 8.
